name: neon
description: Finnomena UI guidance with a persistent Neon conversation mode: say neon to activate and neon off to deactivate. Includes neon-create for React/CDS features, neon-redesign for scoped CSS styling, neon-audit for unclear integration choices, and neon-review for read-only UI reviews. Preserves existing app behavior and supports colors-only, visual-system and full CDS styling depths.
